s1.quote: Kicker Rock is not a site to underestimate. Recreational diving depths usually range between 14 and 25 meters , depending on where you enter and the direction of the current.

s2.quote: The scuba diving tour starts at $250 USD for two dives at depths of 59–98 feet (18–30 m). It requires at least an Open Water certification plus prior experience in currents. … the currents are strong and demand control.

sites.name: Kicker Rock / Léon Dormido, San Cristobal, Galapagos

s1.quote: Experienced divers with a minimum of 25 dives can do these dives at this dive site as the currents range from moderate to strong. … depths up to 30 meters

s2.quote: It is an extinct volcanic crater with a sandy bottom at 32 meters … it is a popular site where intermediate and advanced divers go due to challenging currents and upwellings

highlights.text: Schools of hammerhead and Galapagos sharks

hazards.text: Strong currents and upwellings (the Washing Machine)

summary.text: A sunken volcanic crater off Santa Cruz ringed by three exposed rocks, with a sandy floor near 30 m. Currents and upwellings are strong, so it is for experienced divers, and they pull in schools of hammerhead and other sharks.
